title: Context checkpoint advisory
description: Warns the agent once when context nears the auto-compaction trigger so it can persist working state before the summary fires.
notes: Fires on post_tool_use when context_pct_of_trigger >= 85, once per approach (the once gate re-arms after compaction drops occupancy back below the threshold). The injected note carries live occupancy numbers and concrete wrap-up pointers: durable facts to global memory, in-flight task state to thread memory, open action items to TODOs, and tool_invoke for tools that are not currently bound. Pairs with the proactive idle compaction setting: the advisory lets the agent wrap up mid-turn, the idle timer then compacts in the post-turn quiet window. See docs/agent-systems/hooks.md.

params.text: [Context advisory] Approaching auto-compaction: {context_tokens} of {compact_trigger_tokens} trigger tokens ({context_pct_of_trigger}%). Older messages will soon be summarized into a handoff. Persist important working state now: durable facts via memory_add(scope="global", key=..., content=...); in-flight task state via memory_add(scope="thread", content=...); open action items via nym_todo so they survive the trim. If a tool you need is not bound, run it without binding via tool_invoke. Then continue the task naturally; do not rush to finish before compaction.
